ideas.idea: Give each product its own page with price and availability markup, listing real products
ideas.why: The shop has one sentence and a bare Product with only a name, so real product pages with price and availability would help machines understand the catalogue.

ideas.idea: Expand /shop text to list which pumps, sizes and prices as machine-readable text
ideas.why: The shop page is one short sentence, so concrete product details would give readers and crawlers real content.

ideas.idea: Back up the 'shipped next day' claim with cut-off times and regions on the page
ideas.why: The home page makes the claim, and the only delivery text is in a nosnippet footer, so the claim is unsupported where it can be read.

ideas.idea: Add a meta viewport tag to app.html
ideas.why: It is accurate, since app.html has no viewport tag, but it is a standard item for any site and has little effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Wrap page content in a <main> landmark
ideas.why: It is accurate because the body is a plain div, but this is standard advice that applies to almost any site and has a small effect.
The report itself says it isn't needed. /search is noindex on purpose, so this would work against a deliberate choice.
